correctness.rationale: The channel output determinant separates into the pure-state value plus a nonnegative input-mixedness term, so equality at the entropy roof forces purity. The exact scalar roof \(g_p(q)\) is strictly convex for \(0<p<1\), hence equality in Jensen forces every signal excitation to equal \(q_*\). Proposition 5.6 fixes the ensemble average to the diagonal state \(\tau_*\), which is equivalent to weighted phasor balance. Conversely those conditions give the required average and each signal has entropy \(g_p(q_*)\), so the Holevo value is capacity. A finite set of positive weights closes to a zero phasor polygon iff the largest weight is at most half the total.

originality.rationale: Tang--Zhu--Bai--Wang already prove the fixed-input roof \(\widehat S_{\mathcal A_p}(\tau)=g_p(q)\), exhibit a fixed-excitation pure decomposition attaining it, prove the binary capacity formula, and prove the unique optimal average input \(\tau_*\) for \(p<1\), while explicitly noting that different optimal ensembles are allowed. The audited classification follows by equality analysis of these results: strict convexity of the displayed scalar roof forces every pure signal in an optimal decomposition to have excitation \(q_*\); purity/equality fixes the latitude; averaging to diagonal \(\tau_*\) is exactly the weighted phasor-balance equation. The probability criterion is the standard polygon-closing condition. Under the required implication standard this is a direct corollary of prior results, not an original theorem.

final_claim: For \(0<p<1\), every finite positive-probability capacity-achieving ensemble for the qubit amplitude-damping channel consists of pure states on the unique optimal latitude \(q_*\) with weighted phase balance \(\sum_j\pi_j e^{i\phi_j}=0\); prescribed positive weights are feasible exactly when \(\max_j\pi_j\le 1/2\), with the two-signal case necessarily equiprobable and antipodal in phase.
